name: Georgia
permit_age: You must be at least 15 years of age.
permit_age_quote: You must be at least 15 years of age.
license_age: You must be at least 16 years of age.
license_age_quote: You must be at least 16 years of age.
written_required: You must pass a vision exam and a knowledge exam.
written_quote: You must pass a vision exam and a knowledge exam.
written_detail: You must pass a vision exam and a knowledge exam.
road_required: You must pass a vision exam and road skills test.
road_quote: You must pass a vision exam and road skills test.
road_detail: You must pass a vision exam and road skills test.
supervised_hours: You must have completed a minimum of 40 hours of supervised driving experience, 6 hours of which must be at night.
supervised_quote: You must have completed a minimum of 40 hours of supervised driving experience, 6 hours of which must be at night.
holding_period: You must have held an Instructional Permit (Class CP) for a minimum of one year and a day.
holding_quote: You must have held an Instructional Permit (Class CP) for a minimum of one year and a day.

documents.summary: Under 18, bring a notarized Certificate of School Enrollment signed within the last 30 days, or a high school diploma or GED.
documents.quote: If you are under 18 years of age, you must present a notarized Certificate of School Enrollment (DS-1) form from your school signed within the last 30 days

transfer_summary: If you are new to Georgia, you must surrender any out of state driver's license, permit, or ID card.
transfer_quote: If you are new to Georgia, you must surrender any out of state driver's license/permit/ID card.
teen_summary: Georgia's graduated path starts with an instructional permit at 15 and a provisional license at 16 after the permit is held one year and a day.
teen_quote: You must have held an Instructional Permit (Class CP) for a minimum of one year and a day.

teen_points.text: No driving between the hours of 12:00 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. No exceptions.
teen_points.quote: No driving between the hours of 12:00 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. No exceptions.

curfew: No driving between the hours of 12:00 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. No exceptions.
curfew_quote: No driving between the hours of 12:00 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. No exceptions.
passengers: During the first six months after issuance, no driving with passengers who are not members of the driver's immediate family.
passengers_quote: During the first six months after issuance, no driving with passengers who are not members of the driver's immediate family

name: Washington
permit_age: If you want to get your license before you turn 18, you must complete an approved driver training course. You can apply for a permit as soon as you turn 15.
permit_age_quote: If you want to get your license before you turn 18, you must complete an approved driver training course. You can apply for a permit as soon as you turn 15.
license_age: If you choose not to enroll in a driver training course, you can't get your license until you turn 18. You must also wait until you're 15 and a half to get your permit.
license_age_quote: If you choose not to enroll in a driver training course, you can't get your license until you turn 18. You must also wait until you're 15 and a half to get your permit.
written_required: Take and pass a knowledge test in person at an approved testing location.
written_quote: Take and pass a knowledge test in person at an approved testing location.
written_detail: Take and pass a knowledge test in person at an approved testing location. Fees for testing can vary depending on where you take the test.

documents.summary: Under 18, bring a parent or guardian and documents showing that connection, such as a birth certificate, adoption records, or school records.
documents.quote: If you're under 18, bring your parent or guardian and documents showing parental or guardian connection like a birth certificate, adoption records, or school records.

transfer_summary: A permit from another state cannot be traded for a Washington permit. DOL explains the two options on the learner permit page.
transfer_quote: If you are moving to Washington and already have a permit from another state, there is no way to trade it in for a Washington permit.
teen_summary: Under 18, a learner permit comes first. A license before 18 requires an approved driver training course. Without that course, the license waits until 18.
teen_quote: If you are under 18, you must get a learner permit before you can get your driver license.

teen_points.text: To practice, drive with a licensed driver who has at least 5 years of driving experience.
teen_points.quote: Drive with a licensed driver with at least 5 years of driving experience

out_of_state_permit: There is no way to trade an out of state permit for a Washington permit.
out_of_state_permit_quote: If you are moving to Washington and already have a permit from another state, there is no way to trade it in for a Washington permit.
gaps: A Department of Licensing road test requirement was not on the learner permit page, so no road test fact is listed.
